visual_goal: Show the 2029 transitional state: a cohort register routes each entity to exactly one book of record, moved cohorts are recomputed by a reverse shadow and tied out, and partners read through one read model that hides which book is authoritative.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. At the far left, a stream of small event dots flows along a pipe labeled 'Events' into a large railway-style track switch labeled 'Cohort register'. From the switch two tracks leave: the upper track leads to a ledger book labeled 'SFP subledger' with a small tag 'not yet moved', and the lower track leads to a new shiny ledger book labeled 'New engine' with a small tag 'moved'. Each of the two books has a small gold crown above it. A thin dotted track also leaves the switch and leads to a pale translucent ghost copy of a ledger book labeled 'Reverse shadow', placed below the 'New engine' book. To the right of 'New engine' and 'Reverse shadow' stands a balance scale labeled 'Tie-out', with one arrow from 'New engine' into it and one arrow from 'Reverse shadow' into it. At the upper right, a box labeled 'Read model' receives one arrow from 'SFP subledger' and one arrow from 'New engine'; from 'Read model' one arrow leads to a small group of unlabeled generic people and a house, representing partners. Nine arrows or tracks in total.
alt: A cohort register switch routing events either to the SFP subledger or to the new engine, each crowned as book of record for its cohorts, with a reverse-shadow ghost book tied out against the new engine and both books feeding one read model for partners.
